subject: CAIQ evidence parcel — runtime observability manifest & access escrow
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@orchidhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orchidhealth.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ evidence parcel — runtime observability manifest & access escrow

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the walkthrough on Tuesday. As we prepare the CAIQ submission I need a compact "parcel" of runtime observability artifacts we can hand to our audit team. Specifically we need:

- A manifest listing representative telemetry artifacts (ephemeral logs, sampling windows) mapped to the CSA controls they demonstrate
- A short KV-cache sample (anonymized) as an example of prefix/KV caching behavior for data-flow traceability
- Proof of access controls around the telemetry store (owner, retention TTL, and sampling window)

Can Redwood package those into a single evidence bundle and either upload to our shared Drive or send a DocuSign-enabled package (we need sign-off from legal). Goal: have the bundle available by EOD Monday PST so our compliance team can include it in the CAIQ submission.

Also include any short notes on how batching/caching decisions affect token-level observability — our SOC lead is looking for the minimal set of artifacts to reproduce the control assertions.

Best,
Tara
Tara Singh
Director, Compliance
Orchid Health

Attachments: none

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence parcel — runtime observability manifest & access escrow

Tara —

Thanks for the clear asks. We'll assemble a compact parcel and include a mapping table that ties each artifact to the relevant CAIQ control(s). Plan (high level):

1) Deliverables by EOD Monday PST:
   - caiq-evidence-parcel-index.xlsx (control -> artifact mapping + owner)
   - runtime-telemetry-manifest.csv (artifact id, sample window, retention policy, redaction level)
   - kv-cache-sample-snippet.log (anonymized token/kv footprint)
   - short narrative (2–3 bullets) explaining batching/cache effects on observability

2) Owner and sign-off:
   - Kimberly will produce the manifest and retention/access statements
   - Marissa will assemble the index and prepare the DocuSign bundle if you prefer signed evidence
   - I will attach the kv-cache snippet (anonymized) and sanity-check the assertions against the CAIQ claims

3) Access & escrow:
   - We'll upload to the Drive link you shared and also create a DocuSign package with the artifact index attached. DocuSign link will be returned in a separate email for legal to sign.

Quick Q: do you prefer the artifacts redacted inline (we provide fully redacted logs) or a redaction instruction + sealed sample (we provide a sealed sample and separate redaction attestation)? Redaction affects how the SOC team can sample traces.

I'll start the work and loop back with drafts.

Cheers,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Security Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: runtime-telemetry-manifest.csv (draft), kv-cache-sample-snippet.log (anonymized)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence parcel — runtime observability manifest & access escrow

Grace / Marissa —

Working on the manifest now. Notes for the index:

- Control mappings I plan to include: CCM-5.1 (Logging & Monitoring), CCM-8.2 (Data Retention), CCM-9.4 (Access Control to Telemetry Stores). I'll add short rationale sentences for each mapping (1–2 lines).
- For the kv-cache sample I will redact user identifiers and replace tokens with deterministic placeholders (example: <TOK_0001>). That preserves structure and timings without exposing PHI.
- For the access escrow statement: we'll include the owner roster (engineering owners), retention TTL (30 days for high-frequency traces, 365 days for aggregated metrics), and the KMS envelope rotation cadence.

Marissa — can you draft the DocuSign wrapper? I'll attach the finalized manifest and a short attestation paragraph we should include as the "Control Evidence Statement" for CAIQ responses.
